name: Endless Summer Condo 2312
description:
ENDLESS SUMMER – Your Beach Getaway at Gulf Shores Plantation!

Condo #2312 is a newly renovated condo at Gulf Shores Plantation! Relax and enjoy this fabulous coastal 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo with your family! Everything you need is on this property and once arriving you can "stay and play", never having to leave the resort. With amazing resort amenities, this is a place you will want to visit year after year.

This condo is located in building #2 on the 3rd floor.
